property_summary: For any input where a low-level transferFrom call to a failing callee occurs, the reference contract reverts and therefore returns no success value, while the mutant ignores the failure and returns true; hence if the call succeeds without reverting, it must have made all external calls succeed, which the bug violates by returning true after a failed call.
change_summary: Remove the success check so failed external calls are ignored, changing revert behavior and allowing transfer to complete with true.
